title: Processing Fee Add-Back in the Mortgage Loan File Zero-Tolerance Cure for Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Holders
content:
In the zero-tolerance cure on a Mortgage Loan File, a processing add-back follows the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit reserved against the file, one of Larkspur's Closing Cost Credit programs, read from the credit's status and the occupation verified on it.

| Hometown Heroes Credit reserved against the file | Verified occupation | Added back to the measured increase |
|---|---|---|
| verified | firefighter, law enforcement or emergency medical | the program's processing fee |
| verified | active military or veteran, k12 educator or nurse | 200.00 USD |
| not verified, or none held | — | nothing |

**Clause.** Where the Hometown Heroes Credit reserved against the file is verified for a firefighter, law enforcement or emergency medical occupation, the program's processing fee (as listed in the Larkspur program fee schedule) is added back; where it is verified for an active military or veteran, k12 educator or nurse occupation, 200.00 USD is added back; otherwise nothing is added back.

Hypothetical illustration: on a Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed file (processing fee 595.00 USD), a verified credit for a law enforcement officer adds back 595.00 USD; a verified credit for a k12 educator adds back 200.00 USD.
